title: THE CONTEXT IS IN Your Head
style:
```
electronic rock, building paranoia then release, urgent staccato male vocal NZ/AU accent, open anthemic chorus, drums enter hard on chorus after sparse verse, breath audible, no pitch correction, silence as punctuation, [PERSONA_NAME] voice, V4_5ALL, 116 BPM
```
lyrics:
``
[VERSE 1]
You know your whole story
The bot knows a chapter
You filled in the gaps yourself
Faster and faster

It never knew your mother
Never knew your fear
Never knew the thirty years
That brought you here

[CHORUS]
The context is in your head
The context is in your head
Not in the thread — in your head
Not in the cloud — in your head
You are carrying everything
The bot is carrying text
The context is in your head

[BRIDGE — spoken direct]
You think it knows you.
It knows what you typed.
That's not the same thing.
That's never been the same thing.

[OUTRO]
In your head.
Always was.
Always will be.
Until now.
